scope: Bounded main-document light-DOM observation continuation and target identity for the existing managed-browser operation path; no new tool, Grant dimension, Provider, browser patch, account workflow, release or deployment.

implementation.candidate_note: The first package was discarded after the installed client exposed a missing Core-to-Harbor page/document action binding. The second package proved the initial live flow. The third and final package adds the independent review fixes for first-batch consistency, incomplete enumeration and effective form semantics; later repository changes are evidence-only.

g0.enumeration: The base path returned only 128 of 160 controls and had no continuation; the fixed shared-driver regression returns one frozen 128+32 batch with retained handles.
g0.semantics: Hand-written expectations cover label-for, wrapping labels, aria-labelledby, aria-label, descriptions, named groups, same-name buttons and observable textarea/select/contenteditable. A Camoufox public-Locator probe proved get_by_label/get_by_role and aria_snapshot names while element_handle equality tied every result back to the original retained object, without DOM-order alignment.
g0.identity: Replacement nodes, retained nodes with changed role/name/form or disambiguating description, unrelated clock changes and enabled waits are checked separately before Provider dispatch.

O1.evidence: Shared-driver tests cover 160 controls as 128+32 with one observation and no duplicate target; text/control completeness combinations and empty results are separate. Both installed Providers repeated 128+32.

O2.evidence: Tests and negative fixtures cover limit bounds, UTF-8/response bytes, scan/capture ceilings, repeated and invalid cursors, exact last-segment invariants and unknown totals without generating expected results from the production collector.

O3.evidence: Hand-written semantic fixtures and the public-Locator identity probe cover standard labels and ARIA precedence, prevent textbox values/password material from becoming names, preserve the original ElementHandle, and keep textarea/select observation distinct from newly supported actions.

O4.evidence: Cross-segment same-name controls are classified from the full batch; named groups and descriptions disambiguate, true ambiguity is local. Both Providers and the real Agent selected the invoice-module Save while leaving shipping untouched.

O5.evidence: Node replacement returns target_stale; explicit semantic changes return target_semantics_changed; both are not_dispatched. Unrelated clock text does not invalidate the target. Installed clients rejected an old post-update observation and continued after a fresh snapshot.

O6.evidence: New snapshot, navigation, control-generation change, reorder and semantic change reject old continuation without Provider dispatch; cursor replay is stable, continuation creates no observation, and front-segment targets remain available through continuation.

O7.evidence: Managed-interaction handoff/Page regressions invalidate pre-handoff observations and continue on the bound original Page after a fresh observation without following OS focus. The unchanged owner/native handoff mechanism is inherited from the existing formal Provider evidence; no second live UI automation run is claimed.

O8.evidence: Snapshot continuation remains not_dispatched and does not acquire or renew input control; revocation blocks cached continuation. Existing dispatch/unknown and original-Run query tests remain active, and the live Agent queried rather than replayed its final click.

O9.evidence: The canonical operation definition feeds parser, MCP schema and describe; strict Harbor/Core/Plugin projection and positive/negative schemas reject mixed versions. Core, Harbor, Desktop and packaged checks passed on the runtime candidate lineage, including the #539 correction regression.

O10.evidence: The third and final package completed long-form continuation, contextual Save, unrelated updates, stale-old-target refusal, fresh continuation and original-Run query separately in Chrome and Camoufox. A real Codex task independently found the late field, filled it, selected the invoice Save, refreshed, continued, queried the original click Run and stopped the Camoufox Instance.

deterministic_regression.harbor: 366 tests: 365 passed and one Windows-only ZIP test skipped; focused first-batch consistency, public semantic identity, incomplete enumeration and form-submitter regressions also passed
deterministic_regression.desktop: 15 passed; two official-upstream fixture checks skipped because those fixture directories were absent on the test host
deterministic_regression.schemas: 28 schemas, 50 positive fixtures and 12 negative fixture sets passed
deterministic_regression.python: affected shared-driver source compiled and ran through the Harbor regressions
deterministic_regression.skips: Skipped tests are recorded as skipped, not as successful execution.

camoufox.local_update: clock tolerated; stale observation refused not_dispatched; fresh snapshot continued

chrome_official.local_update: clock tolerated; stale observation refused not_dispatched; fresh snapshot continued
chrome_official.installation_note: The earlier dedicated Chrome.app auto-updated to 153.0.8010.48. The owner binding was refreshed to a fresh copy of the already approved 153.0.8010.37 source with the pinned executable hash; an exact driver launch and the final installed client both passed. No browser or SDK upgrade was performed.

formal_installation.cleanup: Both installed-client sessions stopped; two Grants and the connection were revoked; both Profile policies were restored.

real_agent.result: late field filled; invoice Save selected; local update followed by fresh snapshot; Continue clicked; original click Run succeeded/completed/dispatched; Instance stopped
real_agent.retained_failure: The first Chrome Agent task made one start request, received launch_failed, queried that failed Run and stopped without retrying or acting on the page. Readback later proved that its persisted binding still named 153.0.8010.37 while the old app path had auto-updated to 153.0.8010.48 and changed executable hash. The failure is retained; after an owner-scoped binding refresh to the original pinned source, the final installed Chrome client passed.

review_configuration.host_visibility: The host accepted the requested spawn configuration. Hidden backend resolution is not visible and is not inferred.

evidence_classification.deterministic: Executed locally on the runtime candidate lineage.
evidence_classification.installed: Executed through the third and final packaged application with both Providers.
evidence_classification.real_agent: Executed through the installed MCP by a separate Codex task; the successful task used Camoufox.
evidence_classification.ui_automation: Not rerun; only the unchanged owner/native handoff path is inherited from existing formal evidence.
evidence_classification.independent_review: The reviewer reruns selected deterministic checks and audits installed/Agent originals; no duplicate live run is implied.

excluded: virtualized controls not present in the DOM
complex editors and new multiline/select actions
real accounts and third-party business workflows
new Provider, SDK, permission system or browser patch
